name: Asiimwe 2025 ADC MBMA/CUI PopPK scenarios
description: Exact source anchors plus deterministic fixed-effect cycle-1 ODE scenarios for every dose level used in the paper CUI analysis.

scenarios.name: Exact Table 1 and CUI source anchor
scenarios.description: No-dose exact replay of Table 1 structural model parameters, reported median weights, dosing, and key CUI dose-selection endpoints.

scenarios.name: T-DM1 0.3 mg/kg cycle-1 fixed-effect ODE
scenarios.description: Deterministic two-compartment IV-infusion scenario using Table 1 fixed effects and the paper GitHub median body weight. Paper PK metric summaries are overlaid by the dynamic validation script.
